sections.text:
On a hot summer day, a little ant was walking in the forest feeling very thirsty, looking for a drop of water to quench her thirst.

The ant found a spring of clear water flowing quietly, so she was happy and approached its slippery edge to drink.

As she was stretching out her little head to drink, her foot suddenly slipped and she fell into the cold spring!
The ant was not good at swimming, and it began to flounder in the rushing water, and the small waves were sweeping it away from the shore.

The ant began to drown, struggling to survive, realizing that no one could hear her weak screams for help.

At that critical moment, there was a beautiful white dove standing on the branch of a nearby tree and watching what was happening.

The good dove saw the ant drowning and struggling for her life, and she felt great pity for her.

The dove plucked a small leaf with its beak, flew quickly towards the spring, and dropped the leaf directly next to the ant drowning in the water.

The ant saw the leaf, clung to it with all her remaining strength, and climbed onto it to escape inevitable drowning.

The leaf became a small lifeboat for the ant, and the water gently swept it away until it reached dry land safely.

The ant thanked the dove with all her heart as she looked at it high in the tree, and promised herself that one day she would return the favor if she could.

A few days passed, and one morning, there was a bird hunter wandering through the forest carrying his net and his rifle.

The hunter saw the same white dove sleeping peacefully on the low branch of the tree, so he did not hesitate and decided to hunt it.

The hunter took slow, cautious steps so as not to make any sound that would wake the dove, and he aimed his gun at it to prepare to shoot.

The dove was deep in sleep and did not realize the mortal danger facing her.

But the little ant that the dove saved was nearby looking for food, and she saw the hunter aiming his gun at her friend.

The ant realized the danger, and ran as fast as it could towards the hunter before he pulled the trigger.

The ant crept over the hunter's shoe and quickly climbed onto his bare leg, and with all its strength and determination, it stung the hunter with a very painful bite in his leg!
The hunter screamed out of sudden pain: “Ouch!” He let go of the rifle from his hand, misaimed, and the bullet flew out into the open air!
The dove heard the sound of gunfire and the hunter's scream, so it woke up terrified and immediately realized the danger.

The dove spread its wings and flew high and at high speed, out of the reach of the hunter, to get away and run for its life.

The hunter looked angrily to see what had stung him and lost his fat catch, but he found nothing. The ant had quickly escaped and hid in the grass after successfully performing its mission.

So the little ant returned the favor to the big dove, and we learned that every good deed we do will come back to us one day, and that the smallest creatures can provide the greatest help when we need it.
